title: patrinia scabiosifolia var. hispida
intro: Patrinia scabiosifolia var. hispida, commonly known as hairy patrinia or hispid patrinia, is a plant species in the family Caprifoliaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of hairy patrinia include wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, such as patriniaoside and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
